AddFIDO2Passkey.title: How to create a passkey
AddFIDO2Passkey.step1Description: There will be a pop-up on your device. You may have to enable passkey or your password manager in your device settings to get started.
AddFIDO2Passkey.step2: Follow the remaining steps in the pop-up.
AddFIDO2Passkey.deviceWarningSuffix: the device or password manager containing your passkey. Do not create a passkey on a shared device.

AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.title: Name your passkey
AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.description: You can have multiple passkeys on different devices. Give your passkey a meaningful name so you can identify it later.
AddFIDO2PasskeyNickname.label: Passkey name

VerifyFIDO2Passkey.title: Verify with your passkey
VerifyFIDO2Passkey.description: There will be a pop-up on your device asking for your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
VerifyFIDO2Passkey.helpLink: Help with signing in with a passkey

DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.title: Are you sure you want to delete this passkey?
DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.noLongerUse: You will no longer be able to use your passkey
DeleteFIDO2PasskeyConfirm.deleteFromContact: delete this number from your contact information. To manage your contact phone number, go to

DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.title: Remove passkey from your device or password manager
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.recommendAlso: To ensure your device or password manager doesn’t prompt for this passkey, we recommend also
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.removeFromManager: removing the passkey from your device or password manager.
DeleteFIDO2PasskeySuccess.moreInformation: For more information on how to do this, see the help centre of your password manager or device provider.
